text: The effective number of bits of an analog photonic processor follows from the signal-to-noise ratio as ENOB ≈ (SNR(dB) − 1.76)/___.
explanation: The standard conversion ENOB ≈ (SNR(dB) − 1.76)/6.02 comes from the ideal-quantizer SNR formula (6.02 dB per bit). Current analog photonic processors reach only ~5–8 effective bits, limited by shot noise, thermal noise, laser RIN, and modulator nonlinearity.
